title: Rodilnik: nimam časa, iz Gorice
description: The genitive after a negated verb (nimam časa, ni kruha) and after iz, od and do (iz Gorice, do Ljubljane).

quest.story: Kovač Tone nima železa in nima časa. Vsaka končnica mora biti prava. · Smith Tone has no iron and no time. Every ending must be right.

exercises.instruction: Izberi pravilno obliko · Pick the right form
exercises.explain: After a negated verb the object goes into the genitive: imam čas, but nimam časa.

exercises.instruction: Izberi pravilno obliko · Pick the right form
exercises.explain: iz always takes the genitive: Gorica → iz Gorice, Ljubljana → iz Ljubljane.

exercises.instruction: Izberi pravilno obliko · Pick the right form
exercises.prompt: Danes ni ___. (There is no bread today.)
exercises.explain: 'There is no X' is ni + genitive: ni kruha, ni kave, ni časa.

exercises.instruction: Katere povedi so pravilne? · Which sentences are correct?
exercises.explain: Genitive after nimam and ni (avta, kave) and after do (postaje). Masculine -a, feminine -e.
Nemčija → iz Nemčije. Feminine -a → -e in the genitive.
Neuter -o → -a in the genitive: mleko → nima mleka, vino → ni vina.

exercises.text: Vlak gre od ___ do Ljubljane. (The train goes from Nova Gorica to Ljubljana.)
exercises.explain: Od and do take the genitive, and the adjective changes too: Nova Gorica → od Nove Gorice.

exercises.text: Danes ni ___. (Today there is no wind.)
exercises.explain: The e drops: veter → vetra. The same happens in sestanek → sestanka and hrbet → hrbta.

exercises.prompt: I have no brother and no sister.
exercises.explain: Both objects go into the genitive after nimam: brata, sestre. Sestro would be the accusative (imam sestro).

exercises.prompt: The bus goes from the station to the border.
exercises.explain: od + genitive, do + genitive: od postaje do meje.

exercises.instruction: Povej po slovensko · Say it in Slovene
exercises.prompt: Say that you don't have a car.
